case.summary: Transaction 3509359 ($125.08 online on 2016-12-03) was flagged by the model at score 0.52 and matches the card_not_present_new_device pattern at strength 0.57, involving a device marked new to the account. The cardholder's transaction history shows 112 prior transactions with median amount $94.53, and this is the first use of product code R on the account. Prior case memory returned 8 structurally similar closed cases from the same pattern and region, all 8 confirmed as fraud. The account itself has 2 prior confirmed-fraud cases involving account takeover. However, the case rests primarily on the new device signal combined with the pattern match, and fraud probability is assessed at 0.65, which falls below the 0.70 threshold for blocking without verification. Per policy, verification with the customer or step-up authentication is required before any block decision. The new device alone, while notable, does not constitute proof of fraud, and proceeding to block on this signal would risk declining a legitimate transaction. I recommend MONITOR_CARD for 72 hours and verification of the transaction with the cardholder before determining whether to allow or decline, given the elevated but uncertain fraud probability.
